recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下幾乎全為成片的中大型未成熟細胞，核呈卵圓、摺疊或腎形，染色質細、可見小核仁，並有多個有絲分裂像，缺乏正常成熟造血細胞，提示母細胞浸潤（AML）。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate-to-large immature cells effacing normal hematopoiesis
Oval, indented to folded (monocytoid) nuclei with fine dispersed chromatin
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Several mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic cells; interstitial red cells only
describe_en: H&E-stained section at high power shows diffuse sheets of intermediate-to-large immature cells with oval, indented and folded nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic cells are readily found, and residual maturing granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic elements are not identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia, possibly with monocytic features, in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation; immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry are needed for confirmation and lineage assignment.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5-positive and lack myeloid markers, whereas these blasts would express CD33/MPO or monocytic markers.
Identical cytology but defined by an extramedullary tumor mass, so distinction depends on the anatomic site rather than morphology.
BPDCN cells co-express CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 without MPO or lysozyme.
